Use case: stylized-concept. Generate an animation-ready original cyberpunk street-fighter SPRITE ATLAS for Sandbox Wars. Reference image shows ONLY the desired pixel-art rendering, nine-cell format, and approximate full-body scale. Do NOT copy its human anatomy, clothes, hair or poses. New character specified below.
OUTPUT: square transparent PNG, exactly THREE columns and THREE rows of equal square cells, 9 cells total. Transparent alpha, no floor or ground shadow, no background, labels, lettering, panels or grid lines. All figures must have at least 5% clear padding from every cell edge, absolutely no overflow across cells. Every full-body character faces RIGHT in three-quarter side view, ground baseline 91% down its cell, body scale fixed across first eight cells. Use the whole cell for each figure, leaving room for appendages. Crisp deliberate 16-bit pixel art with visible square clusters and dark outlines, colored shading ramps, no blur or smooth vector outlines.
Frame arrangement: first SIX cells (top two rows) are CLEAN before-the-fight idle frames. Minimal subtle motion of breathing and weight shift through six frames forming a loop; feet planted, identical face, anatomy, clothing and accessories. No injuries, dirt, tears or bandages in these six frames. Bottom left cell is BATTERED exhausted pose. Bottom center cell is BATTERED VICTORY. Bottom right cell is enlarged CLEAN head-and-shoulders PORTRAIT (no injuries or bandages). Keep portrait safely inside its cell. Exact character identity and costume consistency across all nine cells.
Do not make the character a palette swap of the reference. No guns, weapons, text or logos except specifically requested geometric tattoo. No gore, blood, or realistic injury; aftermath is comically exhausted.
CHARACTER: TENSORLAKE, an actual anthropomorphic LIZARD street punk, not a person in a mask. Emerald-green scaled skin with chartreuse cheek and belly highlights, angular reptilian snout, golden eyes with slit pupils, small swept-back row of lime dorsal spines, pronounced thick curved tail. Athletic squat digitigrade stance, three-toed clawed feet and clawed hands. Short sleeveless charcoal utility vest over bare scaled torso, asymmetric neon-green harness and belt, loose dark knee-length shorts, black wrist wraps; no human hair or shoes. Tail curls UP AND IN behind body so it stays within each square cell. Distinct lizard silhouette and expressive mischievous face. Face remains reptilian in portrait.
IDLE six frames: low springy stalking stance, one claw extended forward palm down, other claw near chest, head inquisitively tilted; subtly bob head and tail tip over loop, no boxing fists. Keep torso, claws and tail consistent.
BATTERED bottom left: crouched low with one elbow resting on raised knee, chin in claw, tail drooped and curled on ground around feet, little adhesive bandage on snout, scuffed vest, tired half-closed eyes and annoyed expression.
VICTORY bottom center: weary lizard standing upright hands on hips, broad toothy smug grin, tail curled behind, same snout bandage and scuffed vest; one relaxed shoulder lower. No raised fist.
PORTRAIT bottom right: clean green lizard head, golden eye, short spines, dark vest collar, slight sharp-toothed grin. No bandage.
